entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon and former planeswalker, stripped of his spark and trapped on Zendikar for thousands of years, who has planned for centuries to regain his power through the hedrons.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Zendikar's self-appointed protector, who attacked Ob Nixilis and bound a hedron into him, leaving him weak.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Runed stone devices that line the underground caverns of Zendikar, created as a weapon against the Eldrazi, one of which Nahiri bound into Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: The Veil
entities.description: A weapon Ob Nixilis seized when young, which he says can only destroy the one who wields it.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The wild-mana plane on which Ob Nixilis has been trapped for centuries.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: World-devouring beings rampaging across Zendikar, whom Ob Nixilis admires and expects heroes to oppose.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A place on Zendikar whose destruction Ob Nixilis felt shudder through the world, restoring his sense of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A people of Zendikar whose faces remind Ob Nixilis of Nahiri.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis broods over his two defeats, the first taking his body and the second his spark, and the folly of seeking the Veil.
events.quote: The first robbed me of my body. The second of my spark.

events.summary: Deep underground, Ob Nixilis rotates the hedrons on the cavern walls and casts spells, testing their runes.
events.quote: He rotated a hedron a few degrees and spoke a brief incantation.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis recalls hating Zendikar and its people, and sees Nahiri's face in each of the kor.
events.quote: Because in each of their smug, chalky faces, I see her .

events.summary: Flashback: Ob Nixilis was drawn to Zendikar to purge a curse but was attacked and bound with a hedron by Nahiri, which stopped his curse but crippled him.
events.quote: I couldn't even scream as she bound the hedron into me.

events.summary: Flashback: As the passage crushes in around him, Ob Nixilis drains the stone's vitality and digs toward a green glow.
events.quote: He bought himself a moment by bracing himself between the walls, and he muttered a spell.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis reveals that the bound hedron took his power and that his wings fell off, leaving him small and weak, and vows revenge.
events.quote: The thing she put inside me made me small. Weak.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis studies the hedrons for centuries and lures planeswalkers, letting word of his condition spread until a proud planeswalker comes to extract the hedron.
events.quote: And sure enough, some arrogant child finally took my lure.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis reaches the glowing source in the depths and takes a flower of green and gold power from a tiny sphere of life, laughing.
events.quote: It radiated power, warmth, and health.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis says that heroes coming to fight the Eldrazi will need what he knows about the hedrons, and that he feels his spark within reach after Bala Ged's destruction.

relations.note: Nahiri attacked and bound a hedron into him; he swears revenge.
relations.quote: And for that, one day, I will have my revenge.

relations.note: Ob Nixilis is trapped on Zendikar.
relations.quote: And I am stuck on this disgusting little world
